item.text: The catalog’s category content sits behind a Suspense boundary and an 800 ms product fetch. With Cache Components enabled, the links’ default prefetch only prepares the shell, so I’m switching these category links to full prefetch for each query URL.

item.text:
Updated the category links in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:15) to use full prefetch. Each existing `/catalog?category=...` URL now prepares its category heading and products before navigation, so a click can use the prefetched result without waiting for the server render or showing the loading state once prefetch has completed.

`npm run build` passed.
